_comment: Synthetic Open-i search response (shape of openi.nlm.nih.gov/api/search?query=appendectomy&coll=pmc) for the image search tests. Every article, author, caption and image path is made up; only the Creative Commons licence URLs are real, since the licence filter reads them. Of the 12 figures, 5 list no licence, 4 are CC BY, 2 CC BY-NC and 1 CC BY-NC-ND.

list.title: A synthetic study of immune cells in the colon after removal of the appendix
list.authors: Example A, Sample S, Placeholder P

image.caption: Appendectomy and immune cell density in made-up tumour samples. Twelve invented samples were stained: four from patients with a history of appendectomy and eight without (control group). (A) Representative staining in samples with and without appendectomy. (B) Cell density in the appendectomy and control groups. In all dot plots the bars show the median and quartiles.
